en.headline: CHP records severe paediatric flu case as vaccination drive nears
en.dek: A five-year-old boy with long-term illness is stable in paediatric intensive care with influenza A (H1) complicated by severe pneumonia, the Centre for Health Protection said.
body: The Centre for Health Protection said on Tuesday it had recorded another severe paediatric influenza case, involving a five-year-old boy with a long-term illness who remains in a paediatric intensive care unit in stable condition.

The boy developed a fever and cough on 6 September and was taken to the accident and emergency department at Tin Shui Wai Hospital the next day with shortness of breath. He was transferred to Tuen Mun Hospital’s paediatric ward and later to intensive care. Respiratory samples tested positive for influenza A (H1); the clinical diagnosis was influenza A complicated by severe pneumonia.

The centre said a preliminary investigation found the boy had not travelled during the incubation period. One household contact had recently had mild upper-respiratory symptoms and had recovered. The investigation continues.

From late June to Tuesday, Hong Kong had recorded 17 severe paediatric influenza cases, including one death. The centre said the 2026/27 Seasonal Influenza Vaccination Programme, including school outreach, will start on 17 September, and urged parents to watch for worsening signs such as rapid breathing or persistent fever.

zh.headline: 再錄兒童嚴重流感個案 疫苗計劃下週展開
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心公布，一名有長期病患的五歲男童確診甲型H1流感併發嚴重肺炎，現於兒童深切治療部留醫，情況穩定。
body: 衞生防護中心周二公布，再錄得一宗兒童感染流感的嚴重個案，涉及一名有長期病患的五歲男童，目前在兒童深切治療部留醫，情況穩定。
男童於9月6日出現發燙和咳嗽，翌日因呼吸急促到天水圍醫院急症室求診，其後轉送屯門醫院兒科病房，再因情況轉差入住兒童深切治療部。呼吸道樣本對甲型（H1）流感病毒呈陽性，臨床診斷為甲型流感併發嚴重肺炎。
中心初步調查顯示，男童於潛伏期內沒有外遊，其中一名家居接觸者近日曾有輕微上呼吸道症狀，現已康復。中心會繼續調查。
由6月底至周二，本港累計錄得17宗兒童嚴重流感個案，當中一人死亡。2026/27年度季節性流感疫苗接種計劃（包括學校外展）將於9月17日展開。中心提醒家長留意病童有否呼吸急促或持續發燙等惡化徵狀。
